method: answer-guided query-specific synthetic data + unanimous-checkpoint nomination and confirmed-deletion selective SD

training.selective_final_fit_budget: same positive optimizer-step count as primary full-data pilot
training.selection_refits: full matched-budget SD from identical initial KV and fresh Adam state
training.tracin_rule: nominate deletion only if signed LOO dot < 0 at every checkpoint; do not sum scales
training.deletion_confirmation: both refits improve mean survivor SD loss and every survivor stays within numerical tolerance of current and original pilots
training.training_sequence_tokens: min512/max4096 complete-conversation window independent of cache capacity
training.saved_backward_tensors: CPU pinned memory, original dtype restored on backward
training.tracin_gradient_storage: two backward passes per checkpoint; CPU FP32 running sum plus one trajectory
training.trainable_checkpoint_gpu_residency: one trial at a time, other trials stored on disk
training.post_training_regression_audit: evaluate already-required Vanilla pilot after selection; never use gold to select

slot_note: Publication slots do not assert jobs were submitted for all three backbones.
babilong_protocol: 4 arm paired accuracy; a primary agnostic ordinary-SD pilot sets the shared final optimizer update budget
babilong_answer_policy: saved synthetic answers are fixed teacher response prefixes; sparse soft targets, not hard-label answer NLL
statistical_scope: synthetic snapshot has 1000 request records and 26451 exercises per arm; 352 multi-fact records; 994 paired recalls
